limitations: 32 MiB files and three decoding layers are explicit limits.
The finite scanner does not establish the absence of every possible encoded secret.
Transport verification is not qualification, performance acceptance or candidate adoption.
resolved_findings: Traditional encrypted PEM headers can precede the base64 body with Proc-Type and DEK-Info metadata.
MCP JSONL requires bounded multi-document JSON decoding before nested text payload inspection.
Decoded-byte deduplication must preserve the shallowest depth so a deep earlier visit cannot suppress valid shallow decoding.
review_scope: fixed scopes, traversable ancestry, inventory/SHA consistency, metadata-only omissions, negative outcome preservation, async correctness flag projection and bounded scanner behavior
